The source first holds the isolated surrogate U+D8FF inside a Python Unicode object, then requires UnicodeEncodeError when exporting it as UTF-8. Minyar has no scalar-valued Text/Character representation of that surrogate. Raw malformed file bytes are supported, but reading those bytes and rejecting a later scalar decode reverses the encoding direction and does not preserve this surrogate-object export operation.

The existing 20 incremental-append fixture states preserve all four numeric scalars (36,164,8364,128013), five successive counts1..5, and both complete UTF-8 observations per state. The shared method queries full Text/length/byteLength and every scalar twice after each append, so both source assertions map to their distinct repeated observations. This transfers stale-value/cache-result detection to Minyar immutable UTF-8 and scalar-index caches; it does not claim CPython in-place resize or an internal UTF-8 export cache.
